title: OPSC Geologist 2019 — Paper II (Geology)
description: Official OPSC Geologist 2019 Paper II booklet (T.B.C. GGM-2/2019): 150 questions, 300 marks, 3 hours, covering geomorphology, structural geology, geodynamics, stratigraphy, palaeontology, igneous petrology, sedimentology, rock mechanics and remote sensing/GIS. Three questions with defective options in the original paper are omitted. Answer key prepared by Geo Scholars Academy. No negative marking in the 2019 paper; current pattern is +2 / −0.5.
